req.title: Player payload includes position
req.statement: The system shall include the position field on every player response.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the player payload must include the 'position' field in every response. This is a functional requirement that can be tested by verifying the presence and correctness of the 'position' field in the API response for various scenarios, including valid, invalid, and boundary cases.

tests.name: test_player_position_in_response_positive
preconditions: Player with ID '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0' exists in the database.
actions: Send a GET request to the endpoint '/players/5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0'.
expected: The response JSON includes the 'position' field with the value 'Goalkeeper'.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['position'] == 'Goalkeeper'

tests.name: test_player_position_in_response_negative
preconditions: Player with ID '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a GET request to the endpoint '/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
